subject: Software Engineering
question: What is agile methodology?
option_a: Agile methodology is a sequential approach to software development.
option_b: Agile methodology is an iterative approach to software development.
option_c: Agile methodology is a circular approach to software development.
option_d: Agile methodology is a prototype approach to software development.
explanation: An agile methodology is an iterative approach to software development.

explanation: Agile methodology's each iteration takes approx. 1-4 weeks of the time interval.

subject: Software Engineering
question: How many roles are there in agile methodology?
explanation: Agile methodology consists of two roles: Scrum master and Product owner.

subject: Software Engineering
question: Which of the following are the responsibilities of a Scrum master role in agile methodology?
option_a: Scrum master is a team leader.
option_b: Scrum master helps other members included in the project to work with agile methodology.
option_c: Scrum master is responsible for planning meetings regularly.
explanation: In Agile methodology, a scrum master is a team leader who is responsible for cooperating with the customer as well as the team members so that project meets the requirement. The scrum master is also responsible for planning regular meet-ups, reviewing the agile process, daily calls, etc.

subject: Software Engineering
question: Which of the following are the responsibilities of a Product owner role in agile methodology?
option_a: Product owner explains the requirements of the project.
option_b: Product owner also takes part in meetings and daily stand-up calls.
option_c: Product owners fix the final release date of the project.
explanation: In Agile methodology, the Product owner is the one who wants his application to be built. It explains his project requirement, also in every iteration product owner plays a huge role. It is the project owner who sets the deadline according to his business requirement.

question: Which of the following is/are the advantages of using agile methodology?
